notes.title: October News : Wrapping up the Kickstarter... Back to development!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re [b]back from vacation[/b], bursting with energy, and excited to start sending out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=25csdh]Kickstarter[/url] rewards and continue working on [b]Cat Cafe Manager 2[/b]! ✨

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=25csdh]On Kickstarter, [/url] we managed to collect a whopping [b]88,957 EUR[/url][/b] from [b]2,063 backers[/b] - thank you all [b]SO SO[/b] much! With this money, we won't just be able to create the game of our dreams; we will also be in the position to add the following Stretch Goals: [b]Customizing[/b] your cafe’s outside, [b]Cat Connections[/b], [b]Romanceable NPCs[/b], and [b]Kittens[/b]! 😻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/b3e5d01dcdb13079ff6ef1667944bbc07f7737da.png[/img]

We also managed to unlock [b]two extra hearts[/b] of the [b]Community Goals[/b] with more than [b]2,000 Kickstarter backers[/b] and [b]400 TikTok followers[/b], which means, we’ve unlocked the adorable 🍌 [b]Banana cat hat[/b]!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/5cb409a57807dacbb59d8077a859ddc2628fca0c.png[/img]
[h3]Update on CCM2 Development:[/h3]

[i]Hi, a quick word from game designer [b]Rick[/b] here! We spent the last couple of months fully focused on the Kickstarter campaign, making sure we could show you just how [b]pretty[/b] the game is going to look. However, that also means it's been a while since we actually worked on [b]its gameplay[/b], which will be our main focus in the months to come! Programmer [b]Ernst and I[/b] will be diving back into [b]Unity[/b], the engine we use to build our game in. Time to fire those game development ovens back up![/i] 🧑‍🍳🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/98290c56e6b0ccd9360bdf7a7ba66aa59d3ff6c4.png[/img]

[i]Ernst will focus his efforts on [b]enhancing our development toolset[/b], which will allow us to build the game more quickly and smoothly in the future. Rick will be planning the order of all [b]gameplay elements[/b] so we can decide which ones should be [b]built first[/b]. It's safe to say that these are super exciting times on the game development front![/i] 👀

[b]We will be back next month with more updates about the development of Cat Cafe Manager 2![/b]

Don’t hesitate to [b]reach out[/b] to us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAXW2mx]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/]Reddit[/url], [url=https://x.com/roostgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@roostgames]TikTok[/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager]Instagram[/url] if you have any [b]questions[/b]! Thank you so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/d6ccc5f5516032e9acb3c7b4cc857d1787908745.png[/img]

For now, we want to wish you a[b] very spooky Halloween[/b] from Finley, Boo-Berry and everyone at Roost Games!! 🧙‍♀️

- Irene & Claire

notes.title: 🌟 Last few hours of the Kickstarter! Next Stretch Goal: 😻Kittens!
notes.content:
Hello, we're approaching the end of [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=956xis]the campaign[/url] and we have already reached the 70k€[b] stretch goal[/b]!!!! 🙀 😭 

[list]
[*] €50K unlocked: 🏪 [b]Cafe Outside Customization[/b]
[*] €60K unlocked: 🐱 [b]Cat Connections[/b]
[*] €70K unlocked: 💌 [b]Romanceable NPCs[/b]
[/list]
This means that a bunch of characters will become [b]romanceable[/b]! Get ready for gift-giving, cute dates, and unique story content for each romanceable NPC! 💌 🥰 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/d6973864c05461f3a66bcff68c07e858b0e49798.png[/img]

If we meet the next stretch goal at[b] €80k [/b](88,205 USD) we will include... [b]Kittens[/b] in the game! 😻 

🙀 These [b]tiny furballs [/b]require a little more care than your average feline... but aren't they CUTE?

💪 [b]Kittens [/b]start off with lower stats than most cats, but can become very good little kittens if you [b]spend the time & resources to nurture them[/b].

💖 If certain specific cats get close... your cat cafe might be [b]blessed with a new kitten [/b]soon! Be sure to take good care of the parents, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/e05ed7202aae14d4ef4d8aeaae0baa38856db360.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

We also wanted to share some details about the 🐟😻 [b]Adopting stray cats[/b] mechanic!

🧭 [b]Finding a stray cat[/b] for the first time will add it to your 📀 [b]Cat-o-Dex[/b].
Different strays will appear in different places. If you forget where you found one, you can easily check your Cat-o-Dex!

🌦️ Some strays will [b]only appear[/b] under certain [b]conditions[/b], such as a specific [b]time of day[/b] or [b]weather[/b]. But don't worry, kind folks in town might give you hints on how to find rare stray cats! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/9faf32fec03fc7c02ed75ba5edb11a590329b9c1.png[/img]

Once you [b]find a stray[/b], you can approach them and start a 🐟😻 [b]Stray Encounter[/b]!

These are [b]turn-based encounters[/b] where each turn, you decide how to approach the stray. Try to win their [b]Trust [/b]without [b]startling [/b]them!

✋ [b]Petting [/b]a stray cat is a great way [b]to earn lots of Trust[/b], but it may cause them to get skittish and [b]run away[/b]!

🥫 Most cats can't resist the [b]allure [/b]of [b]cat food[/b]. If they look ready to run, lure them back in with their [b]favorite [/b]treat.

🐱 Some of your [b]Cat Companions[/b] can also [b]help[/b]! Having them cuddle and play with the stray can [b]put the them at ease[/b] and win their [b]Trust[/b]!

For this mechanic, we got inspired by [b]the Pokémon safari zone [/b]and other pacifist turn-based RPGs. I hope you look forward to [b]finding all the stray cats and winning their trust[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

Here's a sneak peek of the [b]Wallpapers [/b] that backers of the 😎[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=956xis]COOL CAT tier[/url] or above will receive in a few weeks! They will be available in different sizes so you can use them for different screen types and devices! 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/7b7c96e9e38af7ee76057d347afc3458f2ac8b4c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

Finally, we're currently running a new pet contest on [url=https://x.com/roostgames/status/1841118904451473646]X/Twitter[/url] and on [url=discord.gg/sAXW2mx]Discord[/url]! We will add one lucky pet to the game, in one way or another. To participate, you can send us your pet picture(s) on this [url=https://x.com/roostgames/status/1841118904451473646]X/Twitter[/url] thread or on [url=discord.gg/sAXW2mx]Discord[/url]. We will pick the winner this weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/d3bb23607d780d8a43c46eb3c49425f9616f9e65.jpg[/img]

We will be back with another update soon after the campaign is done, to let you know how much we were able to raise, and what the next steps of development will be.

If you want to keep an eye yourself to see if we reach the Kittens stretch goal, you can head directly over to our[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=956xis] Kickstarter page[/url].

THANKS SO MUCH EVERYONE!! 

Until then! <3

- Irene and the team at Roost Games

notes.title: 🙀 Final 5 Days of the Kickstarter! Next Stretch Goal: 💌Romanceable NPCs!
notes.content:
Hello! Rick here to let you know [b]we're entering the final week of the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=cjsfjq/]Cat Cafe Manager 2 Kickstarter[/url]![/b] We've been incredibly happy & humbled at the support we've received so far. As I write this we've received [b]€62,062[/b] to help fund the development of the game!! That's amazing!

This also means we've already unlocked 2 🚩Stretch Goals:
[list]
[*] €50K : 🏪 [b]Cafe Outside Customization[/b]
[*] €60K : 🐱 [b]Cat Connections[/b][/list][h3]🚩🏪 Cafe Outside Customization[/h3]
With this feature you won't just get to decorate the [b]inside[/b] of your cafe, but also customize [b]your cat cafe's outside[/b]: [b]colors[/b], [b]decorations[/b], [b]windows[/b], [b]plants[/b], [b]signage[/b], and [b]furniture[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/3aed4b17b591ba8fc42f96a0788c2a53a66843c8.gif[/img]

[h3]🚩🐱 Cat Connections[/h3]
[b]Cat Connections[/b] will see cats in your cafe [b]build connections[/b] as they spend time together!
Most connections are positive, like 💛[b]Lovecats[/b], 😊[b]Best Buds[/b], or 🎲[b]Playmates[/b].
Some connections are troublesome, like 🥊[b]Rivals[/b], 👿[b]Enemies[/b], or 😼[b]Bully[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/fe0fc8c30842091e01db247a9a90f431ee7a0092.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

[h2]Next Stretch Goal: 💌Romanceable NPCs![/h2]
The next [b]🚩Stretch Goal[/b] is set at [b]€70K[/b]: [b]💌Romanceable NPCs[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/80487d71b66384e4a6dc65b518c2fd9126f8ab07.png[/img]

We're [b]massive fans[/b] of games that include dating and romance mechanics, and we adore the idea of including [b]Romanceable NPCs[/b] in Cat Cafe Manager 2!
[list]
[*] 🎁 [b]Give gifts[/b] to friends to grow closer! Better find out their favorite gifts!
[*] 😳 [b]Unique events[/b] trigger when your relationship deepens. If you get close enough, you'll be able to ask to turn your [b]friendship[/b] into a [b]romantic relationship[/b].
[*] 👨‍❤️‍👨 Go on [b]cute dates[/b], and bring a cat or two![/list]
We hope you're as [b]excited[/b] as we are! I'm ready to give Arwel a [i]Pretty Girl Guncat[/i] plastic kit for his birthday! I bet he won't be weird about it, at all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

[h2]😽 Look at some other neat things we've shared over on the Kickstarter?[/h2]
[h3]👚 A peek at character customization![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/039d460a2c838590c6894775c49bfa36741c6f02.gif[/img]
[h3]🍰 A look at some of the food you can prepare![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/c36ca6bafd130e4c49dc658706643d7897f843da.png[/img]
[h3]🧑🏽‍🤝‍🧑🏻 Introducing new characters and returning faces[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/34fba604260bce6e10099cf7c7093bde761b108f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/5d5668478a6d6b4e248f9f8b82ba927aa30f4f1b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

If you're [b]already supporting the Kickstarter[/b], a massive THANK YOU from myself and everyone on the Roost Games team. If you're not, why not [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=cjsfjq/][b]take a peek at the Kickstarter page[/b][/url], see if there's any reward level that fits, and consider helping us [b]expand the game[/b] with new features in the Stretch Goals, like [b]💌Romanceable NPCs[/b]?

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=cjsfjq/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/9d231d83d492bba4b03cd6ed0d079d67adc49c67.png[/img][/url]

Either way, thanks SO much for looking at our little cat game!
- Rick (and all of Roost Games)

notes.title: ✨ FUNDING GOAL MET!! Free gift for all backers! First Stretch Goal revealed!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=79tu2o][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/2c6744294f5be65927ecc3f542e7f5aa256aea18.png[/img][/url]

[h2]🙀 We've successfully reached the 40,000 funding goal on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=79tu2o]the Kickstarter[/url]!

🎁 As a THANK YOU gift, every single backer will get a FREE 📔 [b]digital art book[/b] added to their Reward![/h2]

📔 The digital artbook will feature behind-the-scenes concept art, beautiful high-res art from the game, and juicy nuggets of lore on the world of Cat Cafe Manager 2!

[b]Q: Do I need to change anything about my pledge to receive the Digital Artbook?[/b]
A: No. Every single backer, no matter their Pledge Tier, will receive the Digital Artbook.

[b]Q: Can I get the Digital Artbook if I am not a backer yet?[/b]
All Kickstarter backers will get the Digital Artbook, you have time to become a backer until October 4th!

[b]Q: When will I receive the Digital Artbook?[/b]
A: The digital artbook will be delivered around the same time as the Early Access Launch, mid-2026.

To get the free Digital Artbook, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=79tu2o]back now on Kickstarter[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

[h1]🚩 First Stretch Goal: 🏪 Cafe Outside Customization[/h1]
Now that we've reached the [b]funding goal[/b], it's time to start getting 🚩[b]Stretch Goals[/b]!
[i]For those that don't know, Stretch Goals are additional funding goals that, if reached, allow us to add new features and content to the game![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/e8edafddda1250eca29e6fa1e32ccfb5abb26231.png[/img]
The first Stretch Goal is 🏪[b]Cafe Outside Customization[/b], which will be added to the game if the campaign reaches [b]€50,000[/b].

🏪🛠️ [b]Cafe Outside Customization[/b] will allow you to change the [b]colors[/b], [b]walls[/b], [b]signage[/b], [b]windows[/b], [b]plants[/b] and [b]furniture[/b] outside your cat cafe! We're excited to give you even more ways to build your dream cat cafe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

Did you know we've been posting [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2/posts][b]updates[/b][/url] on the Kickstarter showing new [b]gameplay mechanics[/b], [b]characters[/b] and [b]concept art[/b] for Cat Cafe Manager 2? Here's a little peek at some new and improved cat care gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/1ee60bd0c03965519dcdace095c2b1218bf95f30.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/d118d27d99d185cb6b07004b546c9bef1e957425.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/3107e02cf3660998c45e7418193b12faead4dcd5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

Some of our indie dev friends are also running campaigns on Kickstarter! We'd really love it if you checked them out!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/squareglade/outbound?ref=9bubkf][b]Outbound[/b][/url] for camper-van coziness, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tinymeowstudio/bura-the-way-the-wind-blows?ref=bgfy4m][b]Bora[/b][/url] for Ghibli Zelda-vibes, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sunnylabgames/witch-bakery-paris-2d-adventure-rpg?ref=9phur6][b]The Witch's Bakery[/b][/url] to run a bakery in Paris, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/springfox-games/nif-nif?ref=8xu1zn][b]Nif Nif[/b][/url] for pacifist deck-building, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2awesomestudio/altered-alma?ref=5wwfwv][b]Altered Alma[/b][/url] for metroidvania cyberpunk RPG, and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lookoutdrivegames/bitter-silver-a-cowboy-bebop-inspired-visual-novel?ref=eg8mpe][b]Bitter Silver[/b][/url] for a cool Cowboy Bebop like visual novel. Thanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

And that's the end of this [b]momentous update[/b]!

If you are a backer, I want to thank you from the [b]very bottom of my heart[/b].
When we started working on the original [b]Cat Cafe Manager[/b], I never in my wildest expectations would imagine we'd one day make [b]a sequel[/b], let alone that the game's fans would help fund its development directly. It's so amazing to me, still. Thank you, really.

If you're not a backer yet, [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=79tu2o]right now is a great time to jump aboard[/url][/b]!
Let's go get some [b]stretch goals[/b] and make the game even bigger, better, and fluffier!!

 - Rick (and all of Roost Games!)

notes.title: 😻🎉 The Cat Cafe Manager 2 Kickstarter is live now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/9d231d83d492bba4b03cd6ed0d079d67adc49c67.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

[b]The Kickstarter has officially launched!!!![/b]😱🥳

To support us, check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=1dk8js]Kickstarter page[/url] where you can find out about all the details and surprises! 

❤️It would help us a lot if you could back the campaign as soon as you can, as the first hours are the most important!❤️

We have 10 reward tiers in total! These include the [b]Keyboard Cat Tier[/b], the [b]Lasagna Cat Tier[/b], a very special tier called [b]Good Boy Tier[/b], and the [b]Early Cool Cat Tier[/b] (available only for early backers).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/12f6f6f196d549010a12e6f68e8e7dc438d5a339.png[/img]

All backers will get [b]exclusive news[/b] and [b]updates [/b]about Cat Cafe Manager 2 throughout the entire development process, as well as exclusive access to behind-the-scenes and work-in-progress content! As well as a digital version of the game on Steam, which will be delivered to you as soon as the Early Access version is out!

On the Kickstarter page, we have also revealed more details regarding the [b]Story[/b], [b]Characters [/b](meet Lowri and Bibby💜), [b]Music [/b]and [b]World [b]of[/b] Cat Cafe Manager 2[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/ad2cb78f85ff7171e6974b288c27fc3f1601bfb5.png[/img]

There is also a list of [b]all the rewards [/b]available with a little description of each one, so read that carefully before making a decision, and let us know if you have any questions! It is important to know that your pledge will only be collected [b]once the campaign is over[/b] and [b]successful[/b]. You can [b]edit [/b]or [b]cancel [/b]your pledge before the campaign ends.
